war_stories.label: The Vegas Mode Overdrive
war_stories.description: Engineers used a hidden command (Shift + Option) to force continuous fader motion and max LED brightness, pushing LED heatsinks to 61°C to validate thermal design.

war_stories.label: The Green Bleed
war_stories.description: Sheetmetal chassis physically pressed against LCD flex cables, causing green backlight to bleed into Mute switches; fixed via relief cuts.

war_stories.label: The Solo Mandate
war_stories.description: Management acknowledged Erik Norris was 'solo on the part and assembly drawings' for the entire console, creating a single point of failure.

events.snippet: Parametric catastrophe: D-Control Stand model 'blows up' requiring 6.5hr rebuild.
Vendor quotation received for Fader Top (944012917-00) tooling.
First Danko structure tree released; sheetmetal-only assemblies defined.
Meter boards released for layout; DCDs requested from Architect.
Risk Mitigation: 68K Comm board prioritized for FCS over 5282.
Vegas Mode Overdrive: Fader unit heatsink hits 61°C under stress.
Top Cover Yield Crisis: 'Yields suck (~10%)' due to painting/masking.
All 8 ECOs for PCB assemblies processed; 'Danko Rocks'.
Sheetmetal release (5 of 5) completed.
Governance: Engineering Pilot phase deferred; units designated 'Pre-production'.
Late night 'Wednesday team' fix for headphone circuitry updates.
Sink hole problem identified in plastic Top Covers.
Triage: Non-standard build authorized to meet Jan 31 compliance deadline.
Two units assembled for EMI pre-scan; third unit materials short.
Defect: 'Green Bleed' from LCDs confirmed on pre-production units.
Sideplate inventory ($13k) at risk; rework feasibility questioned.
Headphone jack mechanical conflict: Recess vs Flush mounting debate.
Root Cause: LCD bleed caused by flex cable pressure; relief cuts required.
Rework Failure: Sideplate rework attempt renders parts as scrap.
Compliance Fail: Main and Fader units fail UL AC Withdraw test.
Compliance Pass: UL Notice of Approval received.
Process Fix: Manual 'tweaking' of warped Fader Pans formalized.
BOM Error: Incorrect screw length identified in Bracket Kit.
FCS: First D-Command unit shipped to customer.
Escape: EMI Gasket missing from original BOM; ECO 8114 generated.
Post-FCS Clean-up: List of mechanical ECOs to address ramp issues.
Field Report: Units required shims/straps to 'hold it together'.
Alignment Friction: 4.6% complaint rate on connecting brackets.
Engineering test protos ordered for Rev 22 sheetmetal improvements.
